title: NEXUS - Sunseeker 131 Yacht
highlights: Raised deck with 4-person Jacuzzi and bar
description:
NEXUS is a 40-metre Sunseeker 131 Yacht delivered in 2019, refitted in 2022 and given significant maintenance in 2026. Exterior, interior and naval architecture are all by Sunseeker, for a consistent look throughout.

She accommodates twelve guests in five cabins with eight crew. Outdoor living centres on a raised deck with a four-person Jacuzzi and bar, and she also offers a dedicated gym and equipment for visiting therapists.
